enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +29: Passive: +29 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +15 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.

Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Charisma +6: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Nullification +71: Passive: +71 Insightful bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Insightful Void Lore +13: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 13% Insightful bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Sinister Chill: Whenever you cast a Negative or Cold spell, you gain +50 Temporary Spell Points that last for 30 seconds. This can only trigger once every 45 seconds.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
